dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I've never seen a waterfall in Thailand. Where's a good one?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪv ˈnɛvər ˈsiːn ə ˈwɔːtərfɔːl ɪn ˈtaɪlænd. ˈwɛrz ə ˈɡʊd ˈwʌn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There are some beautiful waterfalls near Chiang Mai.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ər sʌm ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈwɔːtərfɔːlz ˈnɪr ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great! And I've never walked in a jungle.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd aɪv ˈnɛvər ˈwɔːkt ɪn ə ˈdʒʌŋɡəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You can do that there, too. Have you ever been in a cave?
dialogue.reading: juː kən ˈduː ðæt ˈðɛr, ˈtuː. hæv juː ˈɛvər bɪn ɪn ə ˈkeɪv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not with a guide. I've never been in a big cave, but I want to go.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt wɪð ə ˈɡaɪd. aɪv ˈnɛvər bɪn ɪn ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkeɪv, bʌt aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let's go together! There are no jungles in Canada.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ təˈɡɛðər! ðɛr ər ˈnoʊ ˈdʒʌŋɡəlz ɪn ˈkænədə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But there's snow. I've never seen snow!
dialogue.reading: bʌt ðɛrz ˈsnoʊ. aɪv ˈnɛvər ˈsiːn ˈsnoʊ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? Have you ever seen a volcano or a desert?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? hæv juː ˈɛvər ˈsiːn ə vɑːlˈkeɪnoʊ ɔːr ə ˈdɛzərt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've never seen a desert, but I saw Mount Fuji in Japan. It's a volcano!
dialogue.reading: aɪv ˈnɛvər ˈsiːn ə ˈdɛzərt, bʌt aɪ ˈsɔː ˈmaʊnt ˈfuːdʒi ɪn dʒəˈpæn. ɪts ə vɑːlˈkeɪnoʊ!
